effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Gain Herald of Spring, causing your Green Balance overheals to apply Minor Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds. 

Casting a Heal ability while Bracing consumes Herald of Spring and gives you Harbinger of Fall for |cffffff6|r seconds, causing your Green Balance overheals to create an 8 meter area for |cffffff5|r seconds, applying Major Cowardice to enemies and Minor Vitality to allies. You can create an area once every |cffffff5|r seconds.

When Harbinger of Fall ends, regain Herald of Spring.
